about.overview: Our motto says it all, and we truly believe that we are the best cat hotel around.

issues.title: Not mobile-friendly
issues.evidence: The page has no responsive viewport tag, so phones show a shrunken desktop layout.

issues.title: No easy way to get in touch
issues.evidence: No tap-to-call link and no enquiry form on the homepage.

issues.title: No search description
issues.evidence: No meta description, so Google chooses random page text for search results.

issues.title: Images missing descriptions
issues.evidence: 19 of 19 images have no alt text (accessibility and SEO).

issues.title: No local-business search markup
issues.evidence: No structured data, so Google has less to show for the business.
